Omni-Impostor word map

How to correct something

This page is read-only and generated. Data lives in data/files/concepts/concepts.jsonl (concepts, labels, clues) and links.jsonl (links between concepts). Edit them (or use node scripts/words/edit.mjs, see docs/word-map/README.md), then run node scripts/words/compile.mjs and open a pull request. You can also just tell the assistant the id and what to change.

Clue colours: synonym broader contrast (plain clues have no colour). Arrow lines are links to other concepts; es/en marks a link valid in one language only.
